findings.problem: Final approval binds render A to saved episode B's assets and credits. _snapshot reads the current episode at line 147 and builds candidateManifest from it at lines 164–168; _manifest derives credits from episode.scenes at line 193. Neither uses renderRun.output.sceneSnapshot. WorkflowEngine.renderCandidate preserves the current episode version while substituting connected branch scenes (server/workflows.mjs:669–695); execution records those scenes at line 867. Matching version/job/hash guards therefore do not establish matching scene provenance.

findings.problem: Publication selects every workflow node when rebuilding the candidate. candidateManifest consequently resolves every generation target (server/candidates.mjs:127–137), including skipped nodes unrelated to the reviewed render. An unrelated missing scene or slot blocks approval of a completed source-only branch.
